ITEM 1 | Bright yellow grain mixture, loose and fluffy with individual grains, scattered small red and green pieces, a few dark specks, and several whole pale cashew-like nuts on top; sits on the left-center of the plate, roughly 9 cm by 7 cm footprint, about 2 cm tall, slightly moist sheen | 150
ITEM 2 | Plain white steamed rice, moist, clumped and slightly sticky with separate grains visible, mounded in the right portion of the plate, roughly 10 cm by 9 cm footprint, about 3 cm tall, matte with light glossy spots | 180
ITEM 3 | Sliced orange-red roasted vegetable pieces, soft and glossy with slight caramelized browning at edges, cut into rounded slices about 4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, arranged in a cluster at the top-left of the plate beside the yellow grain | 80
ITEM 4 | Dark brown small pieces, glossy and slightly wrinkled, one or two near the yellow grain edge, likely a cooked fruit or vegetable piece, about 1 cm across, sitting among the orange slices | 10
